corrected_text: When LlmMetadata has no max_num_tokens, LiteRT-LM's GetModelInfo infers the context from the last dimension of the prefill masks in the main TFLite section, the largest over the prefill signatures; in our build and the release Agello ships it first reads growing prefixes of the section (16, 64 and 256 MiB, 1 GiB) until one verifies as the graph's flatbuffer, then, as before, the whole section, refusing sections over 2 GiB (2,147,483,648 bytes) (ours: cc97925b): for gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm (b3ca0d2f), whose 818,275,184-byte section holds its weights inline, no prefix verifies and the whole read reports a context of 32,003 (is_dynamic_context true), while the E4B files' main graphs (62.1 and 63.1 MB, weights after the graph) verify on the 64 MiB prefix, so the E4B files (section of 2,260,043,376 bytes in Google's), whose whole read failed and left the context at 0 in v0.18.0, report 32,003 too.
